initScript: (() => { const push=(o)=>{ try{ const c=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('__errLog')||'[]'); c.push(o); sessionStorage.setItem('__errLog', JSON.stringify(c.slice(-20))); }catch(e){} }; const oe=console.error; console.error=function(){ push({t:Date.now(), args:[...arguments].map(a=>{ try{ return typeof a==='string'?a:JSON.stringify(a).slice(0,300) }catch(e){ return String(a) } }).join(' | ').slice(0,900), stack:(new Error().stack||'').split('\n').slice(1,8).join(' <- ')}); return oe.apply(this,arguments); }; window.addEventListener('error',e=>push({t:Date.now(),args:'window.error: '+e.message})); window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection',e=>push({t:Date.now(),args:'unhandledrejection: '+String(e.reason).slice(0,200)})); })();
